rationale: A unanimous, text-and-structure-driven reversal makes the Chief and Justice Kagan the most likely authors, with the opinion emphasizing § 1117(a)'s defendant-centered accounting and equity's traditional tools (joinder/alter ego/agency) rather than enterprise-wide disgorgement. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Alito, Gorsuch, or Thomas to underscore Liu-style limits on equitable disgorgement and/or due-process and corporate-separateness concerns.
